I was hoping to request another one in August, but since the free period ends this month, I'm sending my request a little ahead of schedule.

Hello!  I managed to stumble across your twitter and skeb, and really like your art style.  
I'd like to request a drawing of my FF14 character, if that is okay.
He is a fierce pirate, but does have a fun loving side.  

I was thinking of him preparing for a fight or battle, like cracking his knuckles with a self confident expression, or something like that.  Really, whatever you'd like to do with it is fine with me!

https://imgur.com/a/i7YL2sS Here are his references.  Thank you for your time!

I'm the laughing kettle, and I'm always very grateful.

Thank you very much for the very cool illustration of Zayt!
I'm very sorry to say that I've just made a request, but since it's a commission-free campaign, may I ask for one more item? ......

I'm sorry to say that the taste of this illustration is close to the previous one, but I was wondering if you could draw Eunice and Zayt's father, Wolfe, to complete the family. ......

Nice to meet you, Mr. Vanrizo.
My name is Renen and I'm a freelance filmmaker.

When I was looking for someone who was looking for illustration requests on Twitter, I found Mr. Vanrizo.
When I saw his works, I thought he was a wonderful illustrator who I like very much.
I'd love to work with you! So I've made a request!

I'd like you to draw an icon for me to use on Twitter.

I have an original character of my own.
I'd like you to draw an icon for me to use on Twitter.

I'll put a sample on DropBox.
https://www.dropbox.com/sh/dom79l7q48628nt/AABHTFp4qs2jR9kfhUVzFtbZa?dl=0

I really like the "How to Start a Demon King" drawing of Eunice, so I'd like to request a drawing in that style!

The original character's hair color was originally pink, but I'd like to change the hair color to blue or light blue.
You can change the color of the eyes as you like!

The theme will be beautiful, fragile, and cool!
The theme is beautiful, fragile, and cool, but it's a rough one, so you don't have to put too much thought into it!
The theme itself is a rough one, so you don't have to put too much emphasis on it! I'm sure you'll love it.

I'd like to leave other things like composition and clothing to you!

I know this is a difficult request, but please consider it...!

Nice to meet you.

I saw your picture on Twitter, and I wanted you to draw it for me.

I want you to draw the following.
Satomi Anzai from Venus Eleven (see the material)
Fantasy costumes like Granblue Fantasy or Tactics Ooga. (avant-garde or mid-range)

I will leave the composition and other details to you.

If you like, please let me know.

Hi, my name is Laughing Kettle. I saw your tweet about wrinkles and leather on Twitter and thought, "Wow, that's awesome!　I want to see more of his illustrations! and then "You're doing Skeb! →Then, "You're doing Skeb!　Twitter people are insane! I'm going to send you a request.

So I'd like to send you a request. Can you draw the heroine of my work "How to Start a Demon King", Eunice?

I'll leave all the details of composition and clothing to you.

I'm very sorry to say that I'm a complete newcomer to your work, but I would appreciate it if you would consider it.
Thank you very much.

ミクの日が迫ってしまいましたので日程的に間に合わなさそうであればスルーして頂いて大丈夫なのですが、創薬活動推進キャラクターのこの子 (@souyakuchan: https://twitter.com/souyakuchan) が #ミクの日 に合わせて初音ミク風コスチュームで熱唱しているシーンをお願い致します。
髪色（黒髪に赤メッシュ）は変えずにツインテールにして、衣装の差し色もエメラルドグリーンではなく鮮やかめの真紅でお願いします。ポーズや構図についてはお任せ致します。
このキャラと分かるように髪色と顔と体型が最低限合っていれば大丈夫ですが、スタイリッシュなクールビューティー感は極力意識して頂けると助かります。衣装の布面積は多少減らし気味（デコルテや側胸部や臍周りなど）でもＯＫです。
3月9日 当日に #ミクの日 #創薬ちゃん 及び宛名メンション (.@souyakuchan) を付けるなどしてイラストをツイートして頂けると嬉しいです（ご無理の無い範囲で）。

制作ご検討賜れれば幸いです。
